# xatlas (vendored)

Mesh parameterization / UV unwrapping library by Jonathan Young, MIT licence (`LICENSE`,
copy in `licenses/xatlas.txt`). Files `xatlas.h` and `xatlas.cpp` are unmodified copies of
`source/xatlas/` at commit `f700c7790aaa030e794b52ba7791a05c085faf0c` (2022-07-25) of
https://github.com/jpcy/xatlas. Used by the TRELLIS.2 port (`src/models/trellis2/texture_bake.cpp`)
to chart and pack the object mesh before baking the PBR textures. AI-assisted note, 2026-11-12.
